card.name: Words before the item being inspected
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "final") right after an instruction verb such as inspect, access, or containing, just before a product object like vial, syringe, or container. It appears in preparation and administration steps.

modes.label: Inspect the...
modes.description: "the" after "visually inspect" before the vial, solution, or container.
modes.example: Visually inspect<< the>> vial for particulate matter and disc

modes.label: Access or contain the...
modes.description: "the" after verbs like access or containing, before a syringe or powder.
modes.example: Remove the plastic tube cap of the outer packaging to access<< the>> syringe.

modes.label: The final...
modes.description: "final" after "the" before an admixture or product name.
modes.example: Inspect the<< final>> PN admixture containing Dextrose In
